verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs say you can set budget limits (spend or tokens) on API keys and that usage is automatically blocked once the limit is reached. The same keys can carry rate limits per minute, hour, or day on requests or tokens, with threshold notifications and periodic budget resets, so a dedicated agent key can be capped. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the caps actually halt a runaway agent, and documentation of programmatic or per-agent key issuance workflows.
